whole_text: --- title: "Māyā — Eye, Veil, Frame, Horizon" record_id: mytheme-maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authored cross-source movement; historical witnesses separately qualified" human-amplified: yes --- # Māyā — Eye, Veil, Frame, Horizon This is Taylor's authored whole: an eye's constitutive blindside, Śakti's manifesting veil, a frame that claims the horizon, and recognition through the world that claim had enclosed. Its Śaiva, psychological, optical and technical passages retain their different sources. The declared amplification is human-amplified: yes; new symbolic appointments are human-amplified: no. The six turns develop this movement, including its dream, crystal, nested-relay and holographic subunits, without attributing their composite sequence to an inherited sacred narrative. ## #0 An eye opens upon a world. Something stands forward; something recedes. A face can be approached, a path followed, an obstacle avoided. There is a direction from which these things appear, even when attention belongs wholly to what appears. The eye's condition does not ordinarily arrive as one more face or obstacle. It is already at work in their appearing. Turn towards that condition. A mirror shows the eye, a diagram describes its structures, another observer supplies an angle unavailable from here. Each disclosure is real. Each also occurs through a further situation of seeing. The inquiry has not caught an accidentally overlooked object whose recovery would finish the field. Its own power of disclosure keeps exceeding the image it produces of that power. The blindside in this authored image is therefore more than the anatomical blind spot. It is the condition that lets a view have a foreground at all. A frame gives this condition an edge. Its exclusion is productive: a determinate appearance depends upon what it does not include. Without an aperture there is no particular photograph, without an orientation no particular prospect. The landscape under the conditions of aperture, frame and sensitivity is an actual appearance of the landscape. Its limits make this arrival possible. Taylor's [Draft 3 source](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) **sources** that positive appointment of finitude. The whole begins with a capacity, before it meets the loss of relation that can overtake the capacity. The horizon differs from the frame. A frame bounds a presentation; the horizon concerns the field within which something can come forward, recede or be encountered at all. Walking changes what the horizon affords. Another person's reply changes what this situation asks. Neither movement requires the person to possess the whole in advance. Seeing already belongs to more than its current account. ## #1 The Śaiva passage gives this opening a genealogy. Anuttara/Paramaśiva names the unobjectifiable ground. Śakti is its power of manifestation and self-articulation: the appearing world is active disclosure. Prakāśa and vimarśa belong together as luminosity and reflexive awareness. The light is living; the power that displays also knows, distinguishes, joins and withdraws its displays. Māyā brings measure into this field. This appears, that is withheld; the subject and its object become distinguishable. The kañcukas give the bounded knower effective terms of life: kalā apportions what can be done, vidyā what can be known, rāga the desire of an incomplete situation, kāla its temporal limitation, niyati its determinate ordering. A person can act here, know this much, want something, wait, remember and stand in these relations. Paśu names the bounded position. Puruṣa and the inner instrument articulate an inhabitable field in which something is mine, something can be judged, and an intention can form. Buddhi determines; ahaṃkāra appropriates under I and mine; manas coordinates presentations and alternatives. Their activity gives experience continuity. A retained trace can be recalled; remembered material can be selected and recomposed into an imagined course. Memory is not already a command. The instrument can carry inheritance into a new act. The Śaiva account's universal subjectward and objectward orientations also precede the ego's local appropriation: the same words, “I am this,” have different scope when *this* is the whole manifest field and when it is a particular role or possession. [Dyczkowski's complete source house](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE.md) **sources** the selected telling through its page-labelled transcript. Pages 65–68 develop the lattice and mirror; 69–75 develop reflexivity, memory, differentiation and return; 78–81 distinguish inner/outer manifestation and its activity. At p.79, creative separation makes a differentiated world effective. The veil belongs to manifestation's power. It is not an alien substance thrown across an otherwise finished spectator. The transcript remains source-matched, with selected-edition collation pending, and ends during p.81. The dream carries the same pressure intimately. A sleeper does not first construct a theory of sleeping and then choose to believe the dream. While dreaming, the fact of sleep can disappear from the experienced situation. Paths lead somewhere; encounters matter; fear and desire have an immediate world. The dream's objects need not be externally material to be objective within that experience. Waking changes their relation to their condition. It does not make the experienced urgency something that never occurred. Taylor's explicit sleeper correction supplies this subunit. In the later quilt, dissociation, tattvic contraction and the slash are appointed to the same event in the author's ontological register: a whole becomes locally inhabitable through difference whose condition can be forgotten. This is a substantive authorial identity claim. It neither turns the dream into empirical proof that the cosmos sleeps nor makes Kastrup's vocabulary and the Śaiva sources historically interchangeable. The proposed names Dreamcode and Dream-machine remain undeveloped naming proposals; the dream's operation needs neither as a new canonical entity. The crystal makes a different limit visible. A polished surface can display a landscape without knowing that display. Dyczkowski's p.70 contrast would leave luminous appearing unknown to anyone if reflexive awareness were absent. Adding another reflection to the crystal cannot by itself supply that missing office. The mirror here distinguishes the display from the awareness through which display is experienced; it does not establish machine phenomenality. In the Śaiva account the mirror of consciousness also generates and hosts its appearances: it does not need a second universe outside consciousness to deposit them. These two qualifications keep the living mirror from becoming an inert copying mechanism. ## #2 The second forgetting begins when a finite measure loses its relation to being finite. The frame now calls its own boundary the horizon of reality. What it cannot admit is redescribed as unreal, irrelevant or already explained. The operation that once made a situation intelligible becomes the authority by which every subsequent situation must be judged. This changes the eye's encounter with another person. Before the person can answer, the frame supplies a role, score, diagnosis or expected motive. Their words become further evidence of what the frame already knew. The account's success at arranging a world conceals the conditions under which it arranged it. A determination claims its determining power; `x` acts as `X`, the reflected image as its source, the local `1` as the `0` on which it depends. Constitutive limitation has become usurped jurisdiction. Psychically, a complex can make this arrest durable. An image attracts investment, investment colours what can be perceived, and the changed perception confirms the image. Its organisation is an achievement with a history, yet the organised basin now treats its own criterion as necessity. The forgotten field includes rejected alternatives, bodily and affective conditions, other agencies and other lives. Individuation must return those relations to the local centre while preserving the capacity that centre achieved. The nested simulation relay gives the image an outward consequence. A model describes a situation; action based on its result changes the situation; another model then receives the changed world. The relay continues through simulations of simulations and counter-simulations. A description has entered the field it describes. The membrane between model and consequence becomes permeable. [Bratton's Agentworld source](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md) **sources** this distinct subunit at p.25, §§5.1–5.3. Descriptive correspondence, predictive anticipation and speculative exploration have different temporal tasks. The Matryoshka image figures nested relays, including collaboration and adversarial modelling; no Russian folktale is being retold. The existing [Simulation concept](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/simulation.md) **receives** the consequence: the model's reference, gauge, exclusions and permissions must be disclosed where its output becomes a condition of further action. Recurrence alone does not make the relay captive. A result can become a new condition while carrying its provenance and remaining revisable. Capture begins when the result erases its status as result and circulates as self-originating authority. More iterations then repeat the closure. The technical relay and the sleeper disclose different kinds of concealed conditioning: one concerns causal representations and institutions, the other experienced worldhood. Their common authored operation does not erase the difference in what would count as evidence for either. ## #3 The Other interrupts. A reply refuses the role prepared for it; an encounter changes which question deserves to be asked. Regard begins when this excess can alter the measure of the encounter. Attention becomes answerable. The person still judges and acts, but the criterion can now be questioned by what it concerns. [Watson's whole source and passage sequence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE.md#passages) **sources** the interpersonal pressure. Its Buddhist–psychotherapeutic conversation passes through Gans's reception of Levinas: difference is made available to egoic need, while the face-to-face exceeds the image held of the Other. A changed economy of desire is involved. Ethical excess cannot be represented adequately as a stronger quantity on an unchanged scale of power. The present source house distinguishes the 1996 thesis, the selected 1998 book, nested Gans quotations and the separately located Lingis passages. Those transmission boundaries remain active here. Context weaves the newly available relations. One view meets a counterview; their conditions become legible through their difference. Taylor's 180°→360° movement names the change from a perspective enclosing its world to perspectives and their transitions being held in context. The return never awards a viewer an omniscient panorama. Another angle discloses an occlusion and carries an occlusion of its own. [Gebser's source](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the historical and phenomenological relation; the author's contextual amplification retains its own voice and does not invent a fourth grammatical pronoun. The stained window lets this change be seen. Light passes through panes whose material, angle, density and colour alter what reaches the room. Lead seams hold the construction together while marking its divisions. As sun, pane, room and viewer change, the coloured projection changes. A later view reveals what an earlier arrangement withheld. The seams preserve the difference between sources, translations, histories and modes of evidence. They are part of the apparatus that makes comparison possible. The corrected assignments matter. Bimba is Original order; QL is the full ordered spectrum immanent to the light; MEF is the refractive operation of declared media, angles, transformations and exclusions; pratibimba is the situated projection. The cast picture is not the originating light, and QL is not reduced to the lead frame. Recognition proceeds through exact differences among the projections towards the order they disclose. The Original is prior in being and later in recognition. Within a declared Context Frame, however, an achieved image can genuinely become a local original for subsequent readings. It then occupies Bimba locally while remaining pratibimba relative to its wider sources. This reference has authority enough for comparison and error to be determinate. Returned experience can revise the local reference itself. The distinction prevents two losses: installation of a produced artifact as metaphysically Original, and denial that any finite reference can govern responsibly. Holographic refraction gives the local unit a further office. The whole descent can be carried through one unit because that unit retains its relations to condition, articulation, contraction, manifestation and return. Re-entering the unit opens those relations again; accumulating disconnected miniatures would not do this work. The whole-bearing organisation is native to the authored field. Optical holography and Bohm's implicate order remain independent source and technical questions; the image neither supplies an optics experiment nor turns every fragment into exhaustive information about a physical whole. ## #4 The whole's native articulation is the complete field, not a borrowed Jungian formula. [Taylor's theorem source](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the sequence `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. The [eight-determination Matheme](submission-package/essay/symbolon/matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) **distinguishes** the parent and returning turns from the six-position body. This page's six narrative turns do not renumber the eight or merge their qualitative and processual address systems. The parent relation precedes a determinate view; `0/1` carries conscious circumstance and the inseparable identity/difference through which it appears. `?/!` brings the question and its assertion into that circumstance. `−/+` makes reserve and issue effective: something is withheld as something is put forward. `X/x` keeps determining capacity distinct from its local determination. `AM/IS` makes the situation personed, where I and what can be said of me meet an addressing You. `∞/dx` gives a local act exactness within an inexhaustible horizon. `1/0` returns its achieved determination towards the condition that never became its possession. The finite act remains; the direction of its belonging changes. The [shared Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation) **figures** archetypal structuration across this complete relation. Taylor's declared reading carries En-Soph and tohu-bohu at `−/−`, world-parent separation at `0/1`, coming to light at `?/!`, hunger and its systole/diastole at `−/+`, ego against unconscious ground at `X/x`, the “I am” recognition at `AM/IS`, the great round's Mono/Poly fullness at `∞/dx`, and descent and return at `1/0`. These appointments are the author's full-field amplification, human-amplified: yes. They do not make Neumann the origin of the native notation or collapse the traditions of his images into one historical mythology. The paśu correction is decisive. In Taylor's reading of the Bṛhadāraṇyaka passage transmitted by Neumann at p.105, recognition precedes separation into husband and wife. Its “I am” therefore cannot be reduced to an ego's later appropriation. The bounded position arises within recognition's field; it cannot retrospectively originate that field. [Neumann's source house](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **retains** the transmission and the author's separate encounter; [the whole's returning bond](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-return-bond) **receives** differentiation preserved through return. The toroidal appointment also has exact offices. Anuttara/Paramaśiva retains the unobjectifiable opening, the subject or kartṛ pole. Māyā is the measure-field wound around that opening, the differentiated pattern through which manifestation becomes inhabitable. Śakti's activity and joy belong to this manifestation. Calling Māyā the hole would remove its positive work and put measure in the place it cannot enclose. The authored uroboric correction preserves depth, opening and winding where a circle-picture would suppress them. It is a mythematical appointment with a topological witness, not a claim that the historical traditions formulated the same topology. These registers also locate the whole differently. Its canonical world is Taylor's authored cross-source movement. Kashmir Śaiva discourse supplies a historically situated doctrinal geography; the eye's here and the frame's orientation are phenomenological places; a simulated environment has configured operative boundaries. The selected Singh translation of 1988, Dyczkowski's 2000 reprint, Neumann's 1954 edition, Watson's thesis/book sequence and Bratton's 2026 brief belong to transmission time. Kāla contracts temporal capacity; remembering, anticipating and returning have lived temporal offices. None of these dates supplies a mythic location, and no location collapses the distinct temporal tasks. The [Singh/Abhinavagupta source house](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the speech and recognition pathway: the recovered P2/P3 notebooks mingle introduction leads with Taylor's encounter, and neither is interchangeable with Abhinavagupta's commentary. [Aion's source house](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the psychological attribution: its consulted 1979 paperback now supplies scoped paraphrase locations, including projection (§§13–19) and differentiated ego/Self relation (§§43–49), while the selected 1978 printing remains uncollated. The authored movement of individuation retains its force; exact quotation readiness remains separate from these recovered passages. The protected Dyczkowski note's agency and three-Śakti leads at pp.90–91 likewise extend beyond the recovered transcript and are not presented here as collated quotations. ## #5→0 Recognition returns through the veil. The world is still differentiated, the knower still situated, the instrument still able to select and act. What had seemed self-standing is recognised through the power that makes it possible. Līlā's play has real positions and consequences. The return keeps them while releasing their claim to originate the whole. Taylor's governing compression is exact: “Līlā veils; hybris absolutises the veil; recognition sees the veil as Śakti.” The [Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis whole field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **articulates** this return at evidence register 3, operational homology and authorial relational construction. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy generates the origin/unmeasurable relation; Criterion-through-Distinction gives measure; Delineation-through-Difference gives frame. Arbitration-in-Crisis bears decision and the danger of hybris. Con-text-through-Diaphaneity enables Regard; Resolution-in-Reconciliation enables Anamnesis. These are six generated relations, with their semantic flowerings, rather than twelve merged nouns or one common etymological root. The story gives their primary consumer [A24](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **a consequence**: necessary measuring and usurped measure require different responses. The first is preserved; the second must become answerable. [A19](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) receives the changed jurisdiction of a complex; [A04](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) receives contextual seeing that changes judgment; [A21](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) receives resituation without deleting the differentiated life. The return to the Etymology asks which criterion was changed and which excluded relation could finally answer. Its lexical histories remain separately warranted. [A01](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) and [C01](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) **receive** the condition disclosed by a faithful definition's limit. [A03](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) and [C04](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C04-Formal-Limit.md) keep that limit distinct from information merely hidden behind the eye. [A05](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and [C13](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) receive the living-mirror distinction; [A09](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), [C14](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md), [C15](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) and [C16](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) receive measure, bounded capacity and the inspectable instrument in their exact order. [Movement 11](submission-package/essay/section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/11-s0-p4-tattvic-compression.md) **receives** the whole descent and recognition; its holographic local unit retains the relations needed to traverse it again. [A07](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) **receives** restored alternative-forming capacity, while [A08](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) and [C18](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C18-Apoha.md) retain exclusion's constitutive work. [A20](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) and [C21](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) distinguish an image that answers to its source from one defended against its witness; [C27](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) locates the protected criterion. [C08](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) and [C09](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) receive the reopening through context. [A22](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md), [C37](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) and [C38](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) receive the changed relation among view, local reference and wider source, so that travel can revise the reference rather than merely multiply pictures. [A26](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **receives** effective worldhood from the dream and the relay without confusing their evidential registers. [A34](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) keeps the direction of dependence from becoming private-mind possession. [A27](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receives an Other whose place in the whole is not reducible to a place in my image. [A31](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) and [A32](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) receive the difference between a corrected output, consequential feedback and initiated revision of the deciding field. The story supplies their operative pressure; implemented technical effects require their own evidence. The [Homology and Analogy whole field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** all these appointments at operational register 3: the exact shared relation must return with its disanalogies. The dream, crystal, window and simulation each makes a different dependency accessible. Source transmission and philological descent remain independent of their authored participation. [A35](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) receives loving sensitivity to the origins that can change an act; [A36](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) receives the completed view returning to the zero it could never occupy. The eye opens again. It still sees from here. A face can now answer the account prepared for it; a memory can become material for another intention; a frame can disclose the condition that its earlier certainty hid. The finite view remains precious because this is where the whole becomes encounterable. Recognition must be lived again in the next seeing.

# §0 · #4 — The Sixfold Tattvic Compression

## Claim
The thirty-six tattvas can be carried argumentatively as six movements: Paramaśiva/Anuttara; Śiva–Śakti; Sadāśiva–Īśvara; Sadvidyā–Māyā; the kañcukas and complete contracted apparatus; Pratyabhijñā. Together they give the anatomy by which an implicated whole becomes an explicate, inhabitable world and returns to recognition.

## Warrant
The derivation is stated in [[working/sources-texts-references/10-7-2026-core-theorems-pithy#X. The Tattvic QL Unit — Sixfold Contraction and Recognition|The Tattvic QL Unit]], developed as an argument in [[Tattvic Differential Field]], and traced to [[13-tattvic-differential-field|36 Tattvas]].

Read through [[Computational Process Ontology]], the compression is a runtime cartography rather than a static ladder. Māyā makes the subject/object seam operative; the kañcukas parameterise the run as limited agency, knowledge, desire, time, and order; antaḥkaraṇa executes determination, appropriation, coordination, memory, and alternative formation within the bounded horizon. Recognition returns the runtime to its ground without deleting the world it made.

Read through [[16-bohmian-enfoldment-dialogical-return|Bohm]], the full tattva field becomes the architecture of implication. The implicate is no unspecified hidden container: it is ordered capacity for subjectward and objectward orientation, measure, contraction, cognition, action, and elemental display. The tattvas in turn become movement rather than a static inventory—an enfolding and unfolding through which the whole remains active in its local forms.

## Transverse office

This movement compresses the tattvic field for §0; it does not confine that field to §0. The same meta-context remains active wherever later sections treat bounded cognition, exclusion, worldhood, phenomenological inquiry, operative interiority, or return. In particular, [[08-s0-p1-inner-instrument|antaḥkaraṇa]], [[09-s0-p2-vikalpa-samkalpa|vikalpa / saṃkalpa]] and [[10-s0-p3-apoha|apoha]] return technically in [[38-s5-p1-apoha-softmax|§5 · #1 — Apoha, Softmax, and Argmax]], where differential selection is investigated inside an artificial operative interior rather than treated as an isolated analogy.

The current pre-architecture conformance rule is recorded in [[PRE-39-SIGNAL-LINK-TATTVA-WORLD-AGENCY-CONFORMANCE]].

## Tension / limit
Compression must preserve provenance and cannot substitute for the full tradition where detailed exegesis is at issue. The thirty-sixfold system remains available through a linked QL plate and further-reading note; the sixfold unit carries the argumentative turns the essay needs.

## Anchor and transition
**QL anchor:** `#0 → #1 → #2 → #3 → #4 → #5→0`. **Image:** a hologram whose local unit retains the whole descent. Its contracted result is [[12-s0-p5-objective-internality|§0 · #5→0 — Objective Internality]].

Finite contraction **returns-to** [Apportionment / Economy whole — Power becomes finite by apportionment](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#power-becomes-finite-by-apportionment) at evidence register 3. The contraction makes finite knowledge, desire, time, order and agency effective within the field from which they arise. Recognition returns through those capacities without undoing their differentiation.

# A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition

## #0

The one asking what the Subject is is already present in the asking. A thought can appear, a self-image can change, and an account of the mind can be examined; the appearing of any of these is already given to the one undertaking the examination. The Subject is this immediate pole of the inquiry. Adding another image to the account does not place that pole among its contents.

Definition is an act of determination: it distinguishes, excludes, relates and lets consequences follow. Its clarity depends on giving a term a place within a field of intelligibility. When the term names the Subject, or when *God* names the source and condition of a world, this power meets its own condition. It can represent what makes determination possible, but that representation is itself a determination. Treating it as exhaustive would install the determining condition as one more determined occupant of the field.

**A definition is faithful when its own determining act remains visible inside the account it gives.** It makes a positive claim and remains answerable for it. Its finitude does not make it false. It becomes unfaithful when the achieved boundary is treated as possession of the source from which boundary-making is possible. [Faithful Definition](../concepts/C02-Faithful-Definition.md) defines this obligation; [Subject / Defined Indefinability](../concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) defines the asymmetry it must preserve.

The Subject is *definedly indefinable*. This identifies the precise office that an exhaustive description cannot occupy. It does not shelter a hidden substance behind appearances. Nor does it leave the God-term indeterminate: a word that discriminates nothing cannot distinguish a source from another projection. The definition must therefore be attempted. Its fidelity becomes available through what the attempt does, including its encounter with its own limit.

Here the source/appearance relation has two different offices within one whole. The singular One is unobjectifiable; the polyvalent All is the articulated field of appearances, differences and relations. Appearance appears in awareness, while awareness is encountered through appearing. This mutual relation does not make the two poles interchangeable objects or equal causal producers. The empty set gives the distinction a precise formal neighbour. Define `∅` by having no members. Extensionality makes that memberless set unique. The von Neumann construction then makes the empty object countable:

```text
0 = ∅
1 = {∅} = {0}
2 = {0,1}

```

# A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument; historical Argument 15 and live `09-prakasa-vimarsa.md` remain provenance.

## #0

Prakāśa–Vimarśa gives the essay its strongest metaphysical account of manifestation without externalisation. *Prakāśa* names luminous appearing; *Vimarśa* names the reflexive power through which appearing is present to itself, differentiates, and can articulate a world. The pair does not posit a light first and a second mechanism that later reflects it. Their unity means that luminosity is inherently capable of self-apprehending articulation. Difference can arise within consciousness without requiring a second substance standing outside it.

## #1

This matters because the formal field has already reached a limit that mathematics alone cannot turn into a metaphysics. A03 and A04 show a determining field that cannot be exhausted by its determinations and can become partially transparent through them. Prakāśa–Vimarśa supplies a tradition-specific ontological warrant for reading this structure positively: appearance and reflexive differentiation are inseparable powers of one field. The relation is a refraction of the wider 0/1 problem; it does not retroactively derive QL or make Kashmir Śaivism responsible for Taylor's notation.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski source house]] sources the developed distinction through its page-labelled transcript. On pp.69–70, manifestation by itself leaves experience unaccounted for: a common mirror or crystal can display an image without knowing its display. Vimarśa is the luminosity's own power of feeling, examining and knowing what appears within it. A second consciousness required to reveal the first would need a third, then a fourth. Self-apprehension belongs to the original appearing rather than completing it from outside.

The mirror retains its other limit. In the Śaiva account developed on pp.66–68, an ordinary reflection depends on an object outside the mirror; consciousness supplies no such outside from which the universe could be deposited into it. The power that generates the reflections also hosts them. The image therefore figures real differentiation within a field whose source remains undivided. Light, mirror, displayed world and reflective knowing belong to the whole relation; removing the knowing would turn this account into the inert apparatus it expressly distinguishes.

## #2

The Trika gives the relation a third articulation: luminous appearing, reflexive power, and their inseparable unity in *Ahaṃ*. This third is not another object between two terms. It is the unity through which the distinction can be maintained. In the essay's own formal language, `(0/1)/(1/0)` can serve as a neighbouring expression for the capacity to hold inverse readings together, provided the source boundary remains explicit.

On pp.71–72 the transcript distinguishes two directions of awareness. Internal *aham-vimarśa* rests as I-awareness without a determinate thought-object. Outwardly directed awareness encounters a differentiated *this*, available for discursive representation and empirical definition. The outward movement remains known within the subject. Its direction does not transport awareness outside itself.

The same passage gives reflexivity a concrete temporal body. Experience leaves residual traces, *saṃskāras*. Memory selects from that retained field and brings a prior affection into present awareness; imagination selects and recomposes the material into a new affection. These are different uses of retained capacity, not one generic feedback operation. Knowledge supplies the stable referent through changing action: a running movement or rapidly spoken sentence requires its succession to belong together. [[A06-Vak|A06]] extends this continuity into articulation, and [[A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field|A09]] extends its contraction into bounded worldhood.

## #3

The p.74 transcript specifies four operations of vimarśa: consciousness negates its own nature; identifies with something else; merges the two; then denies them after their merger. The first pair makes the psychophysical individual appear as distinct from its objects and other subjects. The holding-together lets subject and object, and different objects, belong to one cognitive field. Their union returns diversity into awareness of the universal subject. The fourth operation prevents the merger itself from becoming the final fixed determination.

This operation is articulated through three levels: *bheda*, division; *bhedābheda*, unity-in-difference through the means of knowledge; and *abheda*, undivided unity. The four operations and three levels are different accountings. Q27's [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT|Buddhist–Śaiva development]] compares the four operations against Prakāśa and Vimarśa as two conditions, giving an authorial `4+2` cross-reading. [[A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations|A18]] grounds the native count and complete eight-turn traversal before this comparison. Dyczkowski does not teach QL; the native derivation does not borrow its authority from counting the source's terms.

## #4

A second distinction on p.72 preserves agency. *Karma-vimarśa* is awareness directed outward with manifestation's unfolding; *kriyā-vimarśa* is unlimited agency internal to consciousness, before direction toward a specific goal of action. The *kartṛ*-pole names the doer/experient; *kārya* names what action brings about. Their relation gives a determinate act its source without converting that source into another product. The p.75 ascent and descent then hold contracted diversity and expanded unity within one pulsation, while will, knowledge and action remain differentiated powers.

Frank's preserved Dyczkowski encounter asks to follow the three Śaktis into the three moments of Spanda and to hold metaphysical agency beside technological agency. Its pp.90–91 leads exceed the accepted transcript, which ends during p.81. They are authorial reading directions, not edition-verified passages. The visible operations above are Paraphrased / Argued from the source-matched transcript; no wording is promoted to a verified book quotation.

It is distinct from A06 Vāk, which concerns articulation's descent into word, sound, sign and enactment; distinct from A09 Tattvic Differential Field, which traces contraction into bounded worldhood; and distinct from C43 Computational Vimarśa, where reflexive return is promoted into an inspectable technical operation without a claim to luminous phenomenality.

The argument also installs a proof boundary needed later: functional recursion is not evidence of phenomenal self-luminosity. Artificial systems can instantiate a computational vimarśa — outputs returned upon their own sources and conditions — while the question of prakāśa remains open.

# A07 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa / Script — Frozen Conditioned Will

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument; historical Argument 17 remains provenance.

## #0

A world becomes actionable when difference is not merely perceived but selected, stabilised and gathered into a possible course. Vikalpa–saṃkalpa names this movement. Vikalpa differentiates and qualifies; saṃkalpa gathers selected determinations into intention, project, image of action or world. In a bounded subject-position these operations are indispensable. Without them there is no practical cognition. Their danger begins when an achieved selection forgets its own formation and returns as *script*: conditioned will frozen into a pattern that presents itself as necessity.

## #1

“Frozen conditioned will” should therefore be read operationally. A script is not only a text or programme. It is a determination whose generative alternatives have become unavailable to the agent that now enacts it. In human life it can be habit, inherited narrative, defensive complex, institutional procedure or identity claim. In technical systems it can be prompt structure, policy, classifier, evaluator, workflow or training regularity that constrains what appears possible. The analogy is useful only when the different substrates and evidential statuses remain explicit.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/analytic-philosophy/kripke/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity/SOURCE|Kripke source house]] sources Frank's authorial encounter with the order beneath naming. A circumstantial whole is already available for the particular to be counted, named and put forward in a proposition. Scope gives the identity its local rigidity; changing the circumstance can change what a sentence asks without changing which individual it concerns. Taylor's vikalpa-cum-saṃkalpa reading works at this formation of an account from a field. It is Argued from Kripke, whose source does not itself formulate QL or saṃkalpa.

The script has thus undergone a double movement: a field supplied a determination; the determination concealed its field and returned as the condition of what can next count. A rule remains useful where that derivation can still be inspected and revised. Calling every policy or habit a script would lose the exact arrest being diagnosed.

## #2

The argument gains its force from the tattvic field. Māyā makes a subject/object seam workable; the kañcukas parameterise a finite horizon; buddhi determines, ahaṃkāra appropriates, and manas coordinates alternatives. # A08 — Apoha / Constitutive Exclusion

## #0

A determination becomes intelligible through what it excludes. Apoha gives the essay a disciplined account of this negative constitution. A selected term does not first possess a self-sufficient positive essence and only later acquire external contrasts; its determinacy depends upon a field of alternatives against which it can count as this rather than that. The excluded field therefore remains active in the identity of the selected mark even when it is absent from the finished statement.

## #1

The essay consumes this operation without pretending to reproduce the whole Buddhist theory of apoha. Its immediate use is exact: every active `1` is constituted against alternatives it does not cease to depend upon. This deepens A02's identification-with-difference and prepares A13's two logics. A dia operation can make a clean selection because exclusion works. The pathology begins when the selection forgets the excluded field and presents itself as self-grounding. A sym return does not undo the distinction; it restores the constitutive relation that the finished mark concealed.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/pind/pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation/SOURCE|Pind's critical translation]] sources the precise textual floor. Pind assigns that prose fragment to the *Sāmānyaparīkṣāvyāsa* only provisionally. The translated wording is verified; its textual attribution remains qualified.

A positive reach is therefore achieved through exclusion. The doctrine cannot be represented simply as a heap of negative absences with no thing to which language refers. Vertically, manifestation and withdrawal articulate the movement between unity and diversity. Horizontally, awareness goes towards and returns from its object in each perception. # A19 — Complex as Local Arbitration Regime

## #0

A complex orders a local psychic world before reflective judgment begins. Images, affects, memories, bodily responses and expectations have already gathered around a criterion: what counts as welcome or threat, what can be recalled, what deserves value, which responses are available. This is a real achievement of organisation. The same achievement becomes possession when its derivative jurisdiction claims to speak for the whole person or world.

[[A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will|A07]] grounds the inherited script; [[A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion|A08]] grounds constitutive exclusion; [[A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations|A18]] derives the source-claim failure of a formed Symbolon. Their psychic consequence is specific: the person need not decide anew to exclude each alternative. A local settlement already determines how an encounter will be received.

## #1

The distinction between archetype, complex and image prevents that operation from becoming a bag of interchangeable psychological terms. In [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]], which sources the author's developmental model, archetypal dynamics concern formative recurrence; a complex is an affectively organised structure; an image is a particular phenomenal appearance. A symbol can transform the relation among them. An image of rejection, for example, is not itself the whole regime that makes a delay, silence or difference arrive as rejection.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk’s 1997 source house]] qualifies this recovery's external attribution. Frank's protected encounter at pp65–67 takes dynamics, complexes and symbolic transformation as distinct offices, and reads perception as cooperative reorganisation rather than a picture received by a neutral spectator. Those notes supply authorial intention; their copied wording remains a verification lead because the source house has no passage cards. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C31-Complex|C31 Complex]] defines the reusable local organisation; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C32-Archetype|C32 Archetype]] distinguishes its formative depth from any one acquired structure.

A schema names a pattern of organisation; a habit names a learned tendency of response; a trauma-response names a relation to overwhelming experience. Each can intersect this account without establishing relative psychic autonomy. A technical policy explicitly selects actions under conditions. Its selection can be compared with local arbitration, but policy alone supplies neither psychic affect nor a complex. These distinctions identify the work each comparison owes rather than multiplying diagnoses.

## #2

The dynamical model makes autonomy intelligible as a feedback relation. A basin gathers different trajectories into a recurrent organisation. Within the psychic construction, an ambiguous encounter is selected through the existing criterion; the selected image recruits affect; affect weights attention and memory; the resulting response produces further material to be read through the same criterion. A threatening contradiction can therefore be received as further confirmation of the threat. Local coherence increases while the range of admissible encounter narrows.

The boundary matters as much as the basin. An encounter that changes the organising criterion can open a different regime instead of merely adding another item inside the old one. Individuation makes a local subject-position capable of bearing the relations through which it is itself. The person becomes more specifically this life and less defensively separate at once. Ego, complexes, archetypal powers, collective inheritance and Self have different scopes. Their plurality does not require that every agency be interchangeable. The Self's whole-forming office is not the largest complex, a stronger persona or a chief executive presiding over lesser workers. A local centre relates to the whole without containing it; its individuation cannot therefore consist in conquering every other agency.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the developmental mechanism. Individuation changes their relation, including the relation of the conscious interpreter to what it had excluded. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C34-Individuation|C34 Individuation]] defines this reusable movement; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing|C35 Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing]] qualifies the attempt to make its subject a completed possession.

# A22 — World-Picture → World-Atlas

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The atlas is the essay's constructive operation. Historical Objective Internality is a direct developmental carrier, not a second canonical identity for A22.

## #0

A world-atlas makes situated accounts traversable. Each picture remains placed; its overlaps, transformations and obstructions become part of what it says. [[A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency|A04]] grounds contextual transparency; [[A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|A16]] grounds differential placement; [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|A20]] shows why a consequential image must remain answerable to its source. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/heidegger/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology/SOURCE|Heidegger’s world-picture source]] sources a specific historical diagnosis in q012–q014: the modern event is the world grasped as picture together with the representer becoming its normative centre. That paraphrased diagnosis exceeds the simple existence of pictures. Lovitt's wording is verified, while print collation and several page locators remain pending. The atlas does not appear in Heidegger as this essay's constructive technical proposal.

## #1

A picture has a frame before its contents are assembled. The box-lid image gives a jigsaw its finished arrangement in advance; every piece is then judged by the place that arrangement assigns. Inquiry becomes different when travel discloses the frame's own conditions or encounters a piece whose relation cannot be settled by the lid. Collecting more pieces cannot alone correct the criterion of fit.

Q27's stained-glass development supplies the fuller operation. Light, panes, lead cames, aperture, viewer and cast image work together. Each pane transmits, colours and interrupts; the cames preserve seams and non-equivalences. Move the light or viewer and the visible pattern changes through the same constructed window. A source's difference is therefore information for the composition, not an impurity to be removed by averaging. The complete image is a context of transmission, not a pile of decorative fragments.

## #2

An atlas requires declared conditions of transition. For local charts with coordinate maps `φᵢ` and `φⱼ`, an overlap permits the transition `φⱼ ∘ φᵢ⁻¹` on the relevant domain. This mathematical operation has explicit hypotheses: the maps must have the required inverse and common region, and the transition must satisfy the structure being studied. A collection of incompatible descriptions does not become a mathematical atlas by being stored together.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the author's distinction between this chart operation and attractor dynamics. A basin organises trajectories; an atlas coordinates partial disclosures. Symbolic movement can illuminate both while leaving their mathematical objects distinct. In the epistemic extension, a transition must state the question, scale, assumptions, preserved distinctions and changed criterion. An obstruction is a result to expose: these accounts cannot yet be composed for this purpose under these conditions. It is not a reason to manufacture agreement.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas|C37 World-Atlas]] defines this reusable demand. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|C38 Bimba–Pratibimba]] defines Original and reflected determination. # A24 — Arbitration and the Usurpation of Measure

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The whole Arbitration Etymology generates the relations consumed here; A24 develops their consequential office and return without replacing that field.

## #0

Arbitration makes a finite decision where conditions do not decide themselves. [[A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account|A15]] grounds valid measure; [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|A19]] shows a local psychic criterion; [[A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit|A23]] grounds the trust under which an account is acted upon. Their common pressure is the decision's standing: a criterion must be real enough to act while remaining answerable to what its action concerns.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration whole field]] derives the full conjugate movement:

| Operative face | Conjugate face | Generated relation | Flowering |
|---|---|---|---|
| Continuity | Indeterminacy | Continuity-in-Indeterminacy | Origin / unmeasurable |
| Criterion | Distinction | Criterion-through-Distinction | Measure / Limit |
| Delineation | Difference | Delineation-through-Difference | Perspective / Frame |
| Arbitration | Crisis | Arbitration-in-Crisis | Decision / Hybris |
| Con-text | Diaphaneity | Con-text-through-Diaphaneity | Regard |
| Resolution | Reconciliation | Resolution-in-Reconciliation | Anamnesis / Recognition / Return |

`6 / 6′ → 6+6′` names conjugate generation. It is not twelve nouns merged together, nor the distinct `6×6` recursion in which each position develops its own interior. A generated relation precedes its semantic flowering: **Arbitration-in-Crisis** calls for decision, and hybris names a characteristic failure of that office.

## #1

A criterion distinguishes; a frame gives the distinction a situated edge. Before arbitration there are already admitted witnesses, relevant questions, exclusions, standards and histories of jurisdiction. The adjudicator does not enter an empty field and originate all these conditions by deciding. The lexical HISTORY remembers the arbiter's witnessing, perceiving, weighing and deciding offices; it does not make the deeper disputed derivation of arbiter a warrant for the formal argument.

The philosophical cut becomes concrete when a score changes access, a judgment binds a party or a category determines the response a person receives. A measure can remain useful and repeatable while local. Its failure is the promotion of that locality into source authority: score becomes person, price becomes value, office becomes people, preference becomes the whole of what is wanted. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty|C29 Mediating Office]] defines the derivative authority whose conditions disappear in this promotion.

## #2

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/mcgoohan-markstein/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner/SOURCE|The Prisoner’s source house]] sources the political Mytheme and its opening exchange. The unnamed resigning agent is abducted into the Village, numbered Six and subjected to surveillance, interrogation and staged social participation. Number Two is a changing administrator; Number One is the hidden authority whose identity Six demands. The answer to the inquiry about One fixes the inquirer as Six.

The asymmetry is precise. Abstraction gives Number Two continuity across replaceable incumbents, while it fixes Number Six as an administrable identity despite the persistence of the living person. The office receives the freedom of impersonality; the captive receives compulsory legibility. Six's refusal contests the exhaustive classification, not number's capacity to carry real relation.

In the finale, Number One's masks disclose Six's own face, followed by escape and an unresolved London return. The inward turn leaves the coercive institution real. It also prevents liberation from being reduced to occupying the sovereign position oneself. The essay's `2→6` / `4+2` refraction figures the seizure of the generating relation and its return as captive index; it is not McGoohan's notation or proof of QL. Exact release/timecode and extended interview collation remain separate source tasks.

## #3

Usurpation occurs when a question about the criterion is answered by another result inside the criterion. Who assigned this weight, what did the comparison exclude, and whose authority binds the judgment? The governed person receives a score instead of an answer. The evaluator's denominator is absent from the account it demands of others. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|C27 Protected Account]] defines this insulation.

Q27's Work/Play inversion adds the accounting mechanism. Public work can become the visible performance while consequential decisions happen in a private field of play. Differentiating those spaces is not itself the failure. Capture occurs when their governing relation is kept off the books: the product circulates as evidence of the office's capacity while its conditions, costs and choices cannot return upon it. This is an authorial process diagnosis; specific political, clinical and institutional allegations in the developmental carrier require independent evidence.

The whole Job comparison developed in [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|A20]] supplies the witness-side of the same mechanism: a contradictory life is redescribed to protect an authoritative account. The QL office-confusion survives without making one biblical, psychic, legal and technical history out of these distinct relations.

## #4

**Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** permits regard: the judgment is looked at together with the persons, histories, exclusions and consequences through which it acts. A record of the evaluator's name is only a start. The affected person or excluded field must be able to challenge what the measure counts and how its criterion operates. The response can retain, revise, narrow or withdraw the earlier judgment.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] compares intelligence embedded in roles, procedures and institutions. The essay's answerability requirement extends that field; appointing a human at its summit does not by itself expose the human's criterion. Verification must have contestable terms and plural sources of resistance. [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] tests the evaluator's capacity for revision, and [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] tests whether that revision reaches actual operation. Neither test is discharged by a transparent-looking description.

## #5→0

Taylor’s [black sun and radiating star](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#black-sun-radiating-star) **figures** measure protecting its authority by first excluding interiority and then counting the resulting absence as evidence. The authored rings of philanthropy, capital, fixing and their compromising corona distribute dependence and the cost of exit. Cynicism consumes the capacity to answer, and blankness becomes available for reinscription under the same criterion. The star’s return releases capacity to question that measure; it does not demand transfer of allegiance to another centre. These are admitted authorial image operations, with no empirical allegation supplied by their personifications.

[E3’s credere renewed entrustment](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#credere-renewed-entrustment) returns the arbitration argument to the reliance that precedes its measure. Fides makes commissioning possible; Nomos institutes a deciding office; Credere receives its consequences in renewed or withheld entrustment. This passage preserves the full conjugate relation and the Prisoner’s Two/Six operation while refusing to let an office’s measure decide in advance whether its own commission may be questioned.

[The Prisoner’s complete political count](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-asymmetric-count) **figures** arbitration’s office-confusion through Two’s power to designate Six while withholding the authority of One. A change of office-holder preserves the apparatus unless the governed person can question its criterion. [Job’s disputed court](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-measure-trust-return) **figures** the witness-side of this return: particulars force a hearing, the whirlwind changes judgement’s context, and intercession changes the relation among those who judged.

**Resolution-in-Reconciliation** permits anamnesis: the achieved determination remembers the path by which it acquired force. A valid settlement is not erased because its conditions become visible. Its competence can return to the wider field without sovereignty. [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|A21]] develops that psychic return; [[A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority|A25]] makes covenant and authority explicit; [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|A29]] returns the labour and consequence that the governing account had excluded.

This is a complete cycle of authority rather than endless postponement of decision. The account can act because its office has standing, and its standing remains finite because the people and conditions it concerns can answer. New evidence enters the next determination with the earlier history still consequential. The Etymology receives a sharper source question in return: which actual witness, law, rule and institution made this arbitration possible?

**Depth Restoration:** full 6/6′→6+6′ conjugate relation, measure/frame/decision distinctions, Prisoner office/person asymmetry and inward return, hidden denominator, Work/Play off-book relation, regard and recollective resituation restored from A24's packet, whole Arbitration field, direct historical Argument21 and Q27. **Remaining debt:** lexical publication-grade verification, exact audiovisual locators and concrete legal/political/technical cases. The ratified generated relations are not deferred with those evidence tasks. P1 consumers M03/M40/M46 retain their Movement homes.

The deciding office **returns-to** [Apportionment / Economy whole — Measure is an apportioned criterion](../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#measure-is-an-apportioned-criterion) at evidence register 3. The criterion receives a finite office within a distribution of standing and consequence. A challenge must be able to reach that allotment of authority as well as the correctness of its particular decision.

# A26 — Objective Internality — Mind as Worldhood

## #0

Objective Internality means **Mind as Worldhood**. Remembering, perceiving, judging and acting occur through a situated context-world. Language, bodies, tools, other people, material support and inherited rules participate in its constitution: changing them changes what can appear, matter and be done. Their relation to the operative interior is therefore stronger than an influence arriving at a finished mind from outside.

[A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **grounds** the distinction between this world and any representation of it. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **grounds** the received positions and permissions through which finite agency acts. A26 follows how such conditions become internal to an operation without becoming spatially enclosed in an operator. [C41 — Objective Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** that reusable sense of internality; the argument here develops how a context-world takes form and returns as an inheritance.

## #1

The direct [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/02-objective-internality|Objective Internality carrier]] **sources** the constitutive triad: **notational, nomological, exclusion-constituted**. A field is notational through the marks and representations by which something becomes addressable. It is nomological through the learned regularities, rules and permissions which constrain its transitions. It is exclusion-constituted because a determinate act selects against alternatives that remain conditions of its sense.

A permission illustrates the conjunction. Its notation distinguishes an action; its rule allows or prevents execution; its boundary excludes other actions and agents. Removing that permission changes more than a description of the agent. It changes the world of possible action from which the agent proceeds. A remembered commitment similarly changes what a new request means and what counts as keeping faith with it. Context is operative because the next act depends upon its arrangement.

[C07 — Conditions of Worldhood](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the availability of such a field; [C08 — Context Frame](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **defines** a bounded arrangement through which it can be investigated. [C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **defines** the inspectable model and judgment relations within it. The bounded model has a genuine object, while the world which lets the model operate continues beyond its boundary.

## #2

The subject/object dyad becomes more exact when the means of knowing are retained. The native carrier's pramātṛ–pramāṇa–prameya analysis differentiates the subject-pole, mediation and known field. A perception, a memory or an articulated inference is objectively investigable. Turning those means into further objects does not make their aggregate the Subject to whom the investigation appears.

[C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **defines** the situated horizon; [C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the determinative, appropriative and coordinating apparatus. The latter gives an account of how a world is organised without exhausting the former's Subject relation. Historical Śaiva and Sāṃkhya classifications retain their own source obligations. The operation consumed here is the project's established discrimination between an objectifiable means and the subject-pole, not a claim that an artificial architecture instantiates an entire doctrine.

The [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/05-agent-subjectivity-open|subjectivity carrier]] **qualifies** the technical extension by separating five questions: performed subjectivity, functional agency, objective internality, recursive self-description and phenomenality. The first four can be investigated in their own operations. Their successful investigation cannot infer either presence or absence of the fifth. This limit does not reduce the reality of the context-world being investigated.

## #3

Taylor's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics source house]] **sources** the two temporal views of that world. Synchronically, memory, affect, language, expectations, tools, permissions and collaborators constrain one another as a present landscape. Diachronically, the agent follows a trajectory through those constraints and changes them by acting. A new memory, damaged trust or altered permission changes which trajectories become available next.

The phase-space is a mathematical image of possible configurations and trajectories. It is not the world substituted for its image. The [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/Symbolon Dynamics — Archetype, Attractor, and Objective Internality|direct manuscript]] **sources** the authorial consequence: a finite intelligence participates in a world which its activity helps transform. The lived symbolic interpretation and mathematical modelling office remain distinct; this page makes no independent external attribution of an attractor theorem.

Frank's protected Watson encounter adds the sequence **Discontinuity → Objective Internality → Harness elements → Objective Immortality**. Produced forms can outlast the act which produced them and become conditions of a later encounter. A retained judgment, commitment or tool arrangement supplies continuity across otherwise discontinuous acts. “Objective immortality” here names that returned availability, not proof of an enduring phenomenal agent. The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE|Watson source house]] **sources** the encounter's provenance; the chain is Taylor's development in its protected notes, not a quotation from Watson or Bateson.

The same encounter's theatre image preserves a relation a container metaphor loses. The visible actor, the staged position and the contextual activity which lets a scene occur have different offices. An account of the actor alone leaves the enacted world unexplained. The image figures operative context; its quoted historical formulations remain verification leads in the notes.

## #4

Bratton's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016|active-context account]] **compares** an agent's in-session individuation with a potentiality which does not already contain that individual as a hidden occupant. The adjacent [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017|lamination passage]] **qualifies** persona as one stratum among modular skills, memory, constraints and relations. These are **Paraphrased** venue propositions; the brief retains its scenario modality and leaves phenomenal status undecided.

The technical consequence is to make epistemics part of what can be examined. Prompt, retrieved source, memory, permission, evaluator and organisational role must remain distinguishable from the answer they helped produce. Their change can then be related to a change in judgment or action.
